title: Who decides whether a missing file was ever there
description: The G1 verdict driver (#4514) fell back when the base lacked the gate configs but not when the head did, so pre-gate branches failed rc=2 on FileNotFoundError. Steps 2 and 4 now key on the base: a missing head config on a base that carries it is a deletion (gate inputs may not be deleted); a base that lacks it too means the lineage predates the gate and the step skips. Step 3 still judges the tree on the floor.
